metadata.question: In 2003, using MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST) data, did Queensland, Australia record a higher maximum daytime land surface temperature compared to Lut Desert, Iran and El Azizia, Libya?

data.raw_code: We need to answer: In 2003, did Queensland, Australia have higher maximum daytime land surface temperature compared to Lut Desert, Iran and El Azizia, Libya? Key elements: 1. Year: 2003 2. Data: MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST) - likely MOD11A1 product 3. Parameter: Maximum daytime LST 4. Locations: - Queensland, Australia (large polygon region) - Lut Desert, Iran (point/small region) - El Azizia, Libya (point/small region) 5. Comparison: Queensland > both Lut Desert AND El Azizia Data considerations: - MODIS Terra started in 2000, so 2003 data should be available - MOD11A1 provides daily LST data - Need daytime LST (band 'LST_Day_1km') - LST values in Kelvin with scale factor 0.02 - Should mask low quality pixels using QC band - Should get maximum value over the year for each location Plan: 1. Define geometries for three locations 2. Get MOD11A1 collection for 2003 3. Extract daytime LST, apply scale factor, mask poor quality 4. Compute maximum LST for each location over the year 5. Compare values 6. Handle any missing data issues Potential issues: - MODIS data might have gaps - Need to handle QC masking properly - Large area for Queensland might need careful processing ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry definitions // Queensland, Australia - approximate bounding box const queensland = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([138.0, -29.0, 153.0, -10.0]); // Lut Desert, Iran - approximate center point with buffer const lutDesert = ee.Geometry.Point([58.4, 30.0]).buffer(10000); // 10km buffer // El Azizia, Libya - approximate location with buffer const elAzizia = ee.Geometry.Point([13.0, 32.5]).buffer(10000); // 10km buffer // 2. Time period const startDate = '2003-01-01'; const endDate = '2003-12-31'; // 3. MODIS LST data - MOD11A1.061 product const modisCol = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select(['LST_Day_1km', 'QC_Day']); // Check if collection has data const collectionSize = modisCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2003 MODIS Images: ${collectionSize}`); if (collectionSize === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 4. Process LST data - convert to Celsius and mask poor quality const processLST = function(image) { // Get LST band and apply scale factor (0.02 for Kelvin) const lst = image.select('LST_Day_1km').multiply(0.02); // Convert Kelvin to Celsius const lstC = lst.subtract(273.15); // QC mask: bits 0-1 = 00 (good quality) or 01 (other quality) const qc = image.select('QC_Day'); const qcMask = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).lte(1); // bits 0-1 <= 01 return lstC.updateMask(qcMask).rename('LST_C'); }; const processedCol = modisCol.map(processLST); // 5. Create maximum temperature composite for the year const maxLST = processedCol.max(); // 6. Extract maximum temperatures for each region const reducer = ee.Reducer.max(); // Queensland - use 3000m scale due to large area const queenslandStats = maxLST.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: queensland, scale: 3000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const queenslandMax = queenslandStats.get('LST_C').getInfo(); console.log(`Queensland max LST: ${queenslandMax ? queenslandMax.toFixed(2) : 'null'}°C`); // Lut Desert const lutStats = maxLST.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: lutDesert, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const lutMax = lutStats.get('LST_C').getInfo(); console.log(`Lut Desert max LST: ${lutMax ? lutMax.toFixed(2) : 'null'}°C`); // El Azizia const aziziaStats = maxLST.reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: elAzizia, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const aziziaMax = aziziaStats.get('LST_C').getInfo(); console.log(`El Azizia max LST: ${aziziaMax ? aziziaMax.toFixed(2) : 'null'}°C`); // 7. Check for invalid data if (queenslandMax === null || lutMax === null || aziziaMax === null) { // Check if any region has no valid pixels const checkValid = function(val, name) { return val === null || val === undefined || isNaN(val); }; if (checkValid(queenslandMax, 'Queensland') || checkValid(lutMax, 'Lut Desert') || checkValid(aziziaMax, 'El Azizia')) { console.log("C3"); return; } } // 8. Validate temperature ranges (reasonable LST bounds) const isValidTemp = function(temp) { return temp > -50 && temp < 100; // Reasonable Celsius range }; if (!isValidTemp(queenslandMax) || !isValidTemp(lutMax) || !isValidTemp(aziziaMax)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // 9. Compare temperatures console.log(`Comparison: Queensland (${queenslandMax.toFixed(2)}°C) vs ` + `Lut Desert (${lutMax.toFixed(2)}°C) vs ` + `El Azizia (${aziziaMax.toFixed(2)}°C)`); if (queenslandMax > lutMax && queenslandMax > aziziaMax) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
